description: Validate and evaluate supplied candidate flows; no flow is searched for.

cases.name: two-link primary candidate
cases.explanation: Six units are delivered as line_a=5 and line_b=1, so cost = 5*1 + 1*4 = 9.

cases.name: two-link feasible nonoptimal candidate
cases.explanation: The candidate line_a=3 and line_b=3 meets every constraint, so it is accepted even though its cost is higher.

cases.name: two-link over-capacity candidate
cases.explanation: line_a carries 6 units but its capacity is 5.

cases.name: two-link under-delivery candidate
cases.explanation: Only 5 of the required 6 units leave the source, so node balances are violated.

cases.name: transit-node candidate
cases.explanation: Four units pass through the junction; its inflow and outflow cancel, and cost = 4*2 + 4*3 = 20.
